children: Ero Copper temporarily suspended all mining and processing at Tucumã following a SEMAS notice after water overflow events and anomalous pH readings. The company expects to resume after SEMAS reviews and approves its remediation plan.
The halt removes output from an operating mine; timing of the restart depends on regulatory review and approval.
The stated fine adds a direct cost; no comparison period was provided.
The municipality issued this fine, but Ero says it has not received supporting documentation and identified no correlation to its operation.
Rainfall totaled about 275mm in first 20 days of November
This was about 170% above normal seasonal rainfall for the entire month, providing context for the overflow events.

This is a near-term operational and regulatory disruption at Ero Copper's producing Tucumã operation, rather than confirmation of a previously reported production trend. A larger catalyst depends on SEMAS reviewing and approving the remediation plan and the company resuming operations.
from Ero Copper Corp. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
